svg.title: WHERE THE GRID FALLS SHORT
svg.desc: Four gaps a well-run charging hub may leave. The wait: nine to twenty-four months of utility work at one utility. District-run depots: districts that run their own yards pay first and wait for refunds. Overflow: buses beyond the service have nowhere to charge. Backup: one connection feeds the whole fleet; Brooklyn’s battery is still planned. AXIVAI serves each one.
svg.text: Four things a well-run hub still does not solve. AXIVAI serves each one.
A bus company’s yard, owned or leased

g.text: Where the hub works, use the hub. These four are where AXIVAI comes in.
